cases.rediscovery: ORDINARY SURFACE LATER MADE DEFAULT AND MEMORY AFFORDANCES RECOMPILED
cases.summary: The ordinary Security surface survived despite the exact selected t0 commit living on a parallel lineage. The real semantic line was accepted, an orphan 355-LOC baseline wrapper was removed, and Aug24 work made the ordinary surface default, recompiled ordinary-memory affordances and validated them. Current targeted tests pass 12/12. This is healthy contraction plus continued environmentalization, not simple byte preservation.

PF2's NO STRUCTURAL CHANGE result remains current: Host still delegates SQLite/protocol/execution mechanics and has not adopted Restate/DBOS or a workflow control plane. Later Host contraction is directionally consistent, but the counterfactual does not identify PF2 as the cause. S6 claim is therefore justified restraint, not a claimed realized-benefit delta.

The deleted generic capability-policy module remains absent from tracked current source and current Host explicitly rejects generic capability/validity-oracle ownership. Live Host integrity is healthy. The audit initially triggered the boundary test because ignored historical __pycache__ recreated a physical engine directory; after verifying zero tracked files and removing only cache residue, the native Host suite passed 157/157. This is direct evidence that semantic contraction survived while physical residue remains a real maintenance surface.

GoalCoordinatorHost/coordination.py remain absent; current README/ARCHITECTURE explicitly reject shared Goal coordination. The only current source/test occurrence is a forbidden-symbol boundary assertion. Live Host integrity is healthy and, after physical cache cleanup unrelated to tracked semantics, the full native suite passes 157/157.

The Aug19 Method Canon remains current and became a major reusable surface, but four Aug22 closeout/external-solution guards lived only on an archive lineage after owner migration. A later Chapter-5 selection naturally repeated the error those guards were meant to prevent. Aug24 restored the guards to current Canon/first-look, after which later COJC, Assimilation and pressure-selection work reused them. This is the clearest bounded S6 evidence that persistence without current habitation is insufficient.

M0 remained usable and was cited in later challengeability/PAL work, but source advancement made the original Aug19 manual projection incomplete as a current observation. The Aug26 review refined M03 and evidence episodes while rejecting M11/F11/M1. A live Atlas first-look in this audit independently recovered Aug20-21 consequence/value prior work with CURRENT_VERIFIED projection health. The correct long-run behavior is manual rebind under source advancement, not immutable M0 or generated authority.

Claim Standing survived richer real Runtime-effect dogfood without production modification and current targeted tests pass 13/13. But later Harness research explicitly says no production downstream consumer must derive action from a standing set; existing Run/Provider/Tool paths consume narrower facts. Therefore S6 realized production benefit is not identified. Correct restraint is to leave OperationalClaimUseDisposition unimplemented until a real deletion-essential consumer appears.

cases.naturalConsumption: CURRENT WORLD-BOUND EXECUTION CONSUMPTION ESTABLISHED, BUT NOT ATTRIBUTABLE_TO_SELECTED_T0_BRANCH
cases.summary: The selected Aug19 realizability materialization and execute-preflight follow-up are all on a research branch that is not an ancestor of current main. Current Finance does have strong world-bound execution admission/revalidation and 19 current execution/surface tests pass, but the mainline already contained current VenueWorld execution requirements before the selected t0 and later evolved independently. This is a false-positive warning: a successful dogfood/engineering branch must not be counted as S5/S6 current environmentalization without source-lineage or consumer evidence.

OMPC survived four materially different consumer shapes and later became an explicit Book Chapter-2 source for operation-relative representation/currentness/authority boundaries. Media later revalidated the load-bearing OMPC bytes unchanged across owner revision advancement, a direct `newer != superseding` control. No universal serializer/runtime was added. This is the strongest heterogeneous S6 case in the frozen sample.

globalNonClaims: The ten-case sample is purposive by pre-frozen materialization/time criteria and must not be converted into a population success rate.
One-to-two-week T2 evidence does not establish month/year cumulative intelligence or an autonomous ratchet.
Current capability in Finance does not retroactively validate an unmerged historical realizability branch.
Repository survival, test pass, citation or current documentation alone do not establish realized benefit.
Deletion and NO_CHANGE can be positive consequence when current consumers and owner boundaries remain healthy.
No S6 monitor/service/score/consumer graph is admitted.
